metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table — 3D ellipsoidal pleural cavity geometry, spatially resolved CFTR chloride secretion / Poiseuille luminal pressure network, and laryngeal valve (fetal breathing movement) cycle parameters
metadata.note: Values flagged `provenance: literature` are taken from the cited papers (fetal sheep physiology, mouse branching mode); values flagged `provenance: model` are reduced-model choices made in this script and are NOT empirical measurements. DOIs for the three new citations were recorded from memory and could not be verified offline in this pass (see `doi_verified_offline`).

sources.citation: Olver RE, Strang LB (1974). Ion fluxes across the pulmonary epithelium and the secretion of lung liquid in the foetal lamb. Journal of Physiology 241(2):327-357.
sources.used_for: Active chloride secretion as the source of fetal lung liquid (distal epithelium); secretion rate order of magnitude 4-5 mL/kg/h in sheep.

sources.citation: Harding R, Bocking AD, Sigger JN (1986). Upper airway resistances in fetal sheep: the influence of breathing activity. Journal of Applied Physiology 60(1):160-165.
sources.used_for: Laryngeal (upper airway) resistance dominates lung-liquid efflux; resistance falls during fetal breathing movements (glottis opening).

sources.citation: Harding R, Hooper SB (1996). Regulation of lung expansion and lung growth before birth. Journal of Applied Physiology 81(1):209-224.
sources.used_for: Closed-glottis luminal (tracheal) pressure 1-2 mmHg above amniotic pressure; fetal breathing movements present ~40% of time in late gestation; occlusion -> hyperplasia, drainage -> hypoplasia.

sources.citation: Metzger RJ, Klein OD, Martin GR, Krasnow MA (2008). The branching programme of mouse lung development. Nature 453(7196):745-750.
sources.used_for: Orthogonal bifurcation mode: successive bifurcation planes rotated ~90 degrees.

pleural_cavity_geometry.representation: analytic ellipsoid (reduced stand-in for a stereolithographic chest cavity mesh)
pleural_cavity_geometry.pleura_contact_rule: a daughter segment that would cross the ellipsoid is bisected to the pleural surface and its tip is arrested (no further bifurcation)

cftr_secretion_and_poiseuille_network.provenance: model (functional form) / literature (qualitative distal > proximal secretion, olver1974)
cftr_secretion_and_poiseuille_network.profile: j_Cl(g) = j_prox * (j_dist/j_prox)^(g/g_max) per unit epithelial area 2*pi*r*L
cftr_secretion_and_poiseuille_network.pressure_law: P_node = P_amn + R_larynx Q_total + sum_path R_i Q_i  (Lean 4 Law 4)

laryngeal_valve.closed_glottis_plateau_source: harding1996 (1-2 mmHg = 133-267 Pa above amniotic); coincides with the 250 Pa 'elevated_tracheal_occlusion' regime of tracheal_viscous_fingering_reference.json
laryngeal_valve.closed_glottis_plateau_provenance: literature range, point value chosen by model
laryngeal_valve.R_open_over_R_closed_provenance: model (harding1986 reports a decrease during FBM without a universal ratio)
laryngeal_valve.fbm_open_duty_cycle_source: harding1996 (~40% of time in late gestation)
laryngeal_valve.fbm_period_provenance: model (episode durations of tens of minutes)
laryngeal_valve.physiological_mean_delta_P_reference_sou: nelson2017 intact-larynx physiological transmural pressure (150-280 Pa band)
laryngeal_valve.expected_monotonicity: fold-change strictly decreasing in open duty (Lean 4 Law 5), Spearman rho = -1
